name: Paralysis Trap AP
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: Magical symbols carved in the doorframe magically ward this door; anyone attempting to pick the lock is Paralyzed and wracked with pain. Disabling or breaking the trap does not disable or break the lock.
disable:
DC 28 Thievery (expert) to scratch out the magical symbols, DC 28 Arcana (expert) to safely siphon the magical energy, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26)

Bypass Anyone other than Mirida turns the door handle three times to the right and once to the left in quick succession.
reset: The trap automatically resets. It doesn't reset if the trap is disabled.

offensiveAbilities.name: Debilitating Pain
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature tries to unlock or Pick the Lock

Effect The trap deals the triggering creature (2d10+11) Mental Damage damage (nonlethal) (Basic DC 30 Will Saving Throw save) and 1d6 Persistent,mental Damage damage (nonlethal). A creature that fails their save is additionally Paralyzed for as long as they suffer the persistent mental damage.
